probes.title: collects the h2 and h3 of the target in order, h3 a level deeper, and gives each its link

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); const nav = t.querySelector('nav.sf-contents'); const links = [...t.querySelectorAll('.sf-contents-link')]; return nav && document.getElementById(nav.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'))?.textContent.trim() === 'На этой странице' && links.map((a) => a.getAttribute('href')).join() === '#intro,#install,#cdn,#npm,#settings,#events,#a11y' && t.querySelector('a[href="#cdn"]').closest('li').dataset.depth === '1'; })()

probes.title: the first section is current at the top: aria-current location on its link, current is its id

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); const on = t.querySelectorAll('[aria-current="location"]'); return on.length === 1 && on[0].getAttribute('href') === '#intro' && t.current === 'intro'; })()

probes.title: a chosen link makes its section current and sends sf-contents-change once with {id, previous}; the address is written on choose (hash choose, the default, CT-10)

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#toc'); return t.current === 'events' && t.querySelector('[aria-current="location"]').getAttribute('href') === '#events' && location.hash === '#events' && document.activeElement === document.getElementById('events'); })()

probes.title: the sheet's button names the current section and opens and closes the list; Escape gives focus back

steps.check: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#sheet'); const b = c.querySelector('.sf-contents-toggle button'); return c.getAttribute('data-open') === 'true' && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && c.querySelector('.sf-contents-list').getClientRects().length > 0 && /: /.test(b.getAttribute('aria-label')); })()

(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#sheet'); const b = c.querySelector('.sf-contents-toggle button'); return !c.hasAttribute('data-open') && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && document.activeElement === b && c.querySelector('.sf-contents-list').getClientRects().length === 0; })()

probes.title: layout compact is a dated alias of sheet: read as sheet, drawn the same with both classes, noted once in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01 (owner decision C134)

steps.check: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('#sheet'); const b = document.querySelector('#sheet-alias'); const nav = (el) => el.querySelector(':scope nav.sf-contents'); const notes = SF.deprecations.list().filter((note) => note.component === 'sf-contents' && note.from === 'compact'); return b.getAttribute('layout') === 'sheet' && b.getAttribute('data-compact') === 'true' && nav(a).classList.contains('sf-contents--layout-sheet') && nav(a).classList.contains('sf-contents--layout-compact') && nav(b).className === nav(a).className && notes.length === 1 && notes[0].to === 'sheet' && notes[0].remove_after === '2027-01-01'; })()

probes.title: toggle is refused while the layout is not the sheet
links written inside are the items

steps.check: (() => { const g = document.querySelector('#given'); const links = [...g.querySelectorAll('.sf-contents-link')]; return links.length === 2 && links[1].closest('li').dataset.depth === '1' && g.querySelectorAll(':scope > a').length === 0; })()

probes.title: the label follows the page language

steps.check: (() => { const nav = document.querySelector('#en nav'); return document.getElementById(nav.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'))?.textContent.trim() === 'On this page'; })()

probes.title: a public variable reaches the drawing
fewer than two sections draw nothing: the host says data-empty and the navigation takes no box (CT-03)

steps.check: (() => { const one = document.querySelector('#one'); const none = document.querySelector('#en'); const toc = document.querySelector('#toc'); return one.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && none.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && !toc.hasAttribute('data-empty') && one.querySelector('nav').getClientRects().length === 0 && none.querySelector('nav').getClientRects().length === 0; })()

probes.title: the heading is a heading at heading-level and names the navigation (CT-09)

steps.check: (() => { const nav = document.querySelector('#toc nav'); const h = document.getElementById(nav.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); return Boolean(h) && h.getAttribute('role') === 'heading' && h.getAttribute('aria-level') === '2' && !h.hasAttribute('aria-hidden') && !nav.hasAttribute('aria-label') && h.getClientRects().length > 0; })()

probes.title: the rail opens: toggle shows the names as hover does, data-open on the host (CT-04)
the bar puts what does not fit into «Ещё (n)», the current tab in the row (CT-05, overflow more)

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#bar'); const nav = b.querySelector('nav'); const hidden = b.querySelectorAll('.sf-contents-overflowed').length; const more = b.querySelector('.sf-contents-more'); const list = b.querySelector('.sf-contents-list'); return nav.hasAttribute('data-more') && hidden > 0 && more.getAttribute('text') === `Ещё (${hidden})` && !b.querySelector('[aria-current="location"]').closest('.sf-contents-overflowed') && list.scrollWidth <= list.clientWidth + 1; })()
